text:
nina: Heads-up — ran into a weird redwoodctl auth issue while testing local serve behind corp proxy + credential rotation. login returns success but `redwoodctl local serve` fails immediately with 401. anyone seen this?

joel: Can you paste the exact error/log?

nina: log snippet:
```
2026-03-12T14:22:01Z ERROR auth: token refresh failed: 401 unauthorized: token expired
2026-03-12T14:22:01Z INFO  profile: using profile 'work' but token not found on disk
```
Also noticed after `redwoodctl login` my ~/.redwood/profiles.yaml has duplicate keys for the same profile name (one with suffix .rotated).

devex-bot: Ticket created RW-8423 for redwoodctl credential rotation + local serve mismatch.

tom: @nina thanks — this smells like the rotation flow creating a temp profile and not updating the active pointer. quick test: can you try `redwoodctl login --no-rotation` and then `redwoodctl local serve`?

nina: did that. `--no-rotation` lets local serve start fine. But we need rotation for compliance so that's just a temporary workaround.

sara: fwiw I repro'd locally. Steps: 1) login with rotation enabled 2) start `redwoodctl local serve` 3) see 401. Observed that serve reads profile at startup and caches token, but rotation writes a new token file with different name so serve never picks it up.

joel: that explains the duplicate profile entries. Simple fix is to reload profiles on serve start or watch profile file for changes. I'll open a PR to refresh token on start.

nina: can we also make the web reauth flow more explicit? I got "already logged in" in browser and it didn't finish the rotate step. confused which account actually finished.

tom: good point — UX should show: "Rotation complete — returning to CLI" and then CLI should re-read profile. I'll add a small change to the browser callback flow.

joel: PR created: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521 — adds profile reload + unit tests for rotation case.

sara: adding an e2e test that runs login+rotate+local-serve to CI nightly to catch regressions.

nina: awesome, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
